title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
description: An MMO gamer awakens as the Black-Winged Tyrant, Lufas Maphaahl, rising from her sealed fate—only to find this is very real. Her defeat 200 years ago unleashed monsters of death, and the legend is one of terror. Now, trapped in the body of history’s most feared conqueror, he must survive a world that wants her dead…and uncover why he’s here.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After finishing the greatest battle in Exgate Online history, the player gets incarnated as his character.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Lufas journeys to Svel and learns about what happened to the world in her 200 year absence.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Aries attacks Svel, fighting Megrez and Levia.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After beating sense into Aries, Lufas punishes the devilfolk that manipulated him and catches up with Megrez.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Lufas creates an RV golem and enjoys a hot spring with Dina. Then they brave Lufas' grave.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Lufas recovers Libra, leaving Jean's party believing they conquered the Grave of the Black-Winged King.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Lufas takes a pit-stop at the new home of her people and memories resurface. Libra & Aries each uncover a foe.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Tensions in Gjallarhorn are verging on civil war as Lufas debates what to do. Libra grows suspicious of Dina.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Libra captures Jupiter, Lufas stops Aigokeros, and Dina calms the populace. Afterward, Merak get a pep-talk.

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The truth about Dina comes to light and she comes to blows with Lufas. Is she really telling the truth though?

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The true Hero is summoned to defeat the Devil King! Yet his journey starts with encountering both Last Bosses!

episodes_data.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: At her homeland Lufas uncovers the reason for Parthenos' actions and hints to the real Lufas' true goals.
